name: MCU Prep: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: Peter's mythology gets cracked wide open, he navigates a whole new status quo, and he heads back to his roots all over again. A fresh start for Spidey, built on decades of fresh starts before it. Venom Super Special (1995) #1 is still missing provider details; the bonus-story selections open their whole original comics.
groups: Amazing Spider-Man: Brand New Day Vol. 1 (whole Swing Shift original; Venom material gap)
Amazing Spider-Man by Nick Spencer Vol. 1: Back to Basics (whole FCBD original; Spider-Man material)
rows: Free Comic Book Day (The Amazing Spider-Man) (2018) #1
